rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by the Board as described in Rule 480-3-.03; 1 hour = 0.1 CEU (20 hours = 2.0 CEUs)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First cycle: registered in the first 6 months of the biennium - 20 hours; in the following 12 months - 10 hours; in the last 6 months - exempt for that biennium.
rules.audit_note: Board staff may audit a percentage of registrants; keep certificates 2 years from the preceding renewal period. Renewal is not processed until missing CE is provided.
rules.notes: Technician registrations expire June 30 of each odd-numbered year; certificates must be dated within the biennium. CE required on and after July 1, 2023.
